name: Roman Kopylov
summary: A Russian southpaw pressure striker and a classic measuring stick: too skilled for most newcomers, but beaten on points by the better middleweights (Paulo Costa, Gregory Rodrigues). Stops 94% of takedowns.

how_they_fight.Striking: Aggressive southpaw with kicks and volume (about 4.3 significant strikes a minute); finished Chris Curtis in 2025.
how_they_fight.Grappling: Solid wrestling defense and a willingness to wrestle himself: previewers see takedowns as his best route against Gautier.
how_they_fight.Defense: Absorbs about as much as he lands; beaten over three rounds by bigger, better strikers.
how_they_fight.Fight IQ: Experienced; knows how to make fights ugly.

sources.author: E. Spencer Kyte
